ARM = "right"
Z_PUSH = 0.930

obs = current()
S, reg, bpoly, ppoly = pushlib.block_state(obs)
al = pushlib.alignment(reg, bpoly, ppoly)
print("ALIGN before: theta %.2f dc %s" % (al["theta_deg"], al["dc"]))
bv = pushlib.verts(bpoly)

# current gripper opening -> pushing face offset
st = query("robot_state")
op = float(st["arms"][ARM]["gripper_normalized"])
disp = 0.044*(op - 0.185185185185185)/0.815
foff = pushlib.FINGER_OUTER_AT_ZERO + disp
print("opening_norm %.4f disp %.5f foff %.4f" % (op, disp, foff))

D_DEG, GAP, TRAVEL, PRE_Z = 170.0, 0.015, 0.015, 1.00
sp = pushlib.down_push(bv, D_DEG, GAP, TRAVEL, Z_PUSH, foff)
print("d %s n %s q %s p_start %s p_end %s" % (np.round(sp["d"],3), np.round(sp["n"],3),
      np.round(sp["q"],4), np.round(sp["p_start"],4), np.round(sp["p_end"],4)))

def mk(p, interaction, z=None):
    p = np.array(p, float)
    if z is not None: p[2] = z
    return target(Point(p, "world"), approach=Direction([0,0,-1.0], "world"),
                  jaw_line=Direction([float(sp["d"][0]), float(sp["d"][1]), 0.0], "world"),
                  interaction=interaction)

pre = sp["p_start"].copy(); pre[2] = PRE_Z
rc = query("reach_check", arm=ARM, poses=[pushlib.pose7(pre, sp["quat"]),
           pushlib.pose7(sp["p_start"], sp["quat"]), pushlib.pose7(sp["p_end"], sp["quat"])],
           interaction="free_space")
print("reach:", [(x.get("reachable"), x.get("reason")) for x in rc.get("results", [])])
if not all(x.get("reachable") for x in rc.get("results", [])):
    handoff("push poses unreachable", d_deg=D_DEG)

dr = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(pre, "free_space")}, dry_run=True)
print("transit dry:", dr.feasible, dr.failure_code, "|", dr.summary)
if not dr.feasible:
    handoff("transit infeasible", failure=dr.failure_code)
r0 = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(pre, "free_space")})
print("transit:", r0.status, r0.ok, r0.failure_code, "err", r0.target_error_m)
if not r0.ok:
    handoff("transit failed", failure=r0.failure_code, status=r0.status)

r1 = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(sp["p_start"], "precision", z=Z_PUSH)}, speed="careful")
print("descend:", r1.status, r1.ok, r1.failure_code, "err", r1.target_error_m)
tw = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
gap_now = float(tw[:2] @ sp["d"] + foff - sp["proj_q"])
print("tcp after descend", np.round(tw,4), "gap_now %.4f" % gap_now)
if abs(tw[2]-Z_PUSH) > 0.004 or gap_now < 0.005:
    tgt = sp["p_start"].copy(); tgt[2] = Z_PUSH
    tgt[:2] = tw[:2] + (0.012 - gap_now)*sp["d"]
    r1b = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(tgt, "precision")}, speed="careful")
    print("adjust:", r1b.status, r1b.failure_code)
    tw = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
    gap_now = float(tw[:2] @ sp["d"] + foff - sp["proj_q"])
    print("tcp after adjust", np.round(tw,4), "gap_now %.4f" % gap_now)
    if gap_now < 0.003:
        handoff("cannot establish a clear gap", gap_now=gap_now)

p_end = tw.copy(); p_end[2] = Z_PUSH
p_end[:2] = tw[:2] + (gap_now + TRAVEL)*sp["d"]
r2 = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk(p_end, "contact_approach")}, speed="careful")
print("push:", r2.status, r2.ok, r2.failure_code, "err", r2.target_error_m, "contact", r2.contact)
tw2 = np.array(current().pose(ARM).position.xyz)
print("tcp after push", np.round(tw2,4), "moved %.4f" % float(np.linalg.norm(tw2-tw)))

obs2 = current()
S2, reg2, bpoly2, ppoly2 = pushlib.block_state(obs2)
al2 = pushlib.alignment(reg2, bpoly2, ppoly2)
print("ALIGN after: theta %.2f dc %s" % (al2["theta_deg"], al2["dc"]))
print("RESPONSE dtheta %.2f deg  dc %s  |dc| %.4f" % (
    al2["theta_deg"]-al["theta_deg"], (al2["c_block"]-al["c_block"]), float(np.linalg.norm(al2["dc"]-al["dc"]))))

# ---- vertical (down) approach face push -------------------------------------
def down_push(bv, d_deg, gap, travel, z, foff, q=None):
    """Gripper points straight down; jaw_line = d; finger_1 outer face (normal +d) pushes.
    The face is a vertical rectangle spanning 0.0716..0.1576 below the TCP and +-0.0306 along n=(dy,-dx)."""
    ar = np.deg2rad(d_deg)
    d = np.array([np.cos(ar), np.sin(ar)]); n = np.array([d[1], -d[0]])
    proj = bv @ d
    if q is None:
        q = bv[int(np.argmin(proj))]
    q = np.asarray(q, float)[:2]
    sd = float(q @ d); sn = float(q @ n)
    p = (sd + gap - foff)*d + sn*n
    p3 = np.array([p[0], p[1], z])
    a = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0]); j = np.array([d[0], d[1], 0.0])
    M = np.stack([a, j, np.cross(a, j)], axis=1)
    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    return {"d": d, "n": n, "q": q, "p_start": p3,
            "p_end": p3 + travel*np.array([d[0], d[1], 0.0]),
            "quat": Rotation.from_matrix(M).as_quat(), "proj_q": sd}

"""Closed-loop planar push controller for push_T."""
import json, os
import numpy as np
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
from robot import tools, target, query, handoff
import pushlib

ARM = "right"
Z_PUSH = 0.930
PRE_Z = 1.00
GAINS_PATH = "/work/gains.json"

def load_gains():
    if os.path.exists(GAINS_PATH):
        return json.load(open(GAINS_PATH))
    return {"kc": 0.69, "kth": 1.27}   # kc: |dc|/s ; kth: deg per mm per unit sin(phi)

def save_gains(g):
    json.dump(g, open(GAINS_PATH, "w"))

def measure():
    obs = current()
    S, reg, bpoly, ppoly = pushlib.block_state(obs)
    al = pushlib.alignment(reg, bpoly, ppoly)
    return S, bpoly, ppoly, al, pushlib.verts(bpoly)

def face_off():
    st = query("robot_state")
    op = float(st["arms"][ARM]["gripper_normalized"])
    disp = 0.044*max(0.0, (op-0.185185185185185))/0.815185185185185
    return pushlib.FINGER_OUTER_AT_ZERO + disp

def support(bv, d):
    return bv[int(np.argmin(bv @ d))]

def pick(verts, c, base_deg, sin_des, span=40.0):
    """direction nearest base_deg whose sin(phi)=|tau|/(|r|) is closest to sin_des (tau>0)."""
    best = None
    for off in np.arange(-span, span+0.001, 1.0):
        dd = base_deg + off
        ar = np.deg2rad(dd); d = np.array([np.cos(ar), np.sin(ar)])
        q = support(verts, d); r = q - c
        L = np.linalg.norm(r)
        tau = r[0]*d[1] - r[1]*d[0]
        sphi = tau/L
        if sphi <= 0.02: continue
        cost = abs(sphi - sin_des) + 0.004*abs(off)
        if best is None or cost < best[0]:
            best = (cost, dd, d, q, sphi, L)
    return best

def mk_target(p, d, interaction, z=None):
    p = np.array(p, float)
    if z is not None: p[2] = z
    return target(Point(p, "world"), approach=Direction([0, 0, -1.0], "world"),
                  jaw_line=Direction([float(d[0]), float(d[1]), 0.0], "world"),
                  interaction=interaction)

def move(p, d, interaction, speed="fast", z=None, label=""):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: mk_target(p, d, interaction, z)}, speed=speed)
    return r

def plan_push(verts, c, dc_target, theta_err, g):
    base = np.degrees(np.arctan2(dc_target[1], dc_target[0]))
    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(dc_target))
    ratio = abs(theta_err)/max(dist, 1e-6)              # deg per mm needed
    sin_des = float(np.clip(ratio/g["kth"]*g["kc"], 0.12, 0.62))
    p = pick(verts, c, base, sin_des)
    if p is None:
        return None
    _, dd, d, q, sphi, L = p
    s = float(np.clip(dist*0.65, 0.010, 0.026))
    return {"d_deg": dd, "d": d, "q": q, "sin": sphi, "lever": L, "s": s,
            "base": base, "sin_des": sin_des}

    from shapely.geometry import Polygon
    ab = Polygon(reg["src_contour"]) 
    from shapely.affinity import affine_transform
    R = reg["R"]; t = reg["t"]
    ab2 = affine_transform(ab, [R[0,0], R[0,1], R[1,0], R[1,1], t[0], t[1]])

    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(dc))
    sgn = 1.0 if theta_err >= 0 else -1.0
    best = None
    for dd in np.arange(0.0, 360.0, 1.0):
        ar = np.deg2rad(dd); d = np.array([np.cos(ar), np.sin(ar)])
        q = support(verts, d); r = q - c; L = np.linalg.norm(r)
        if L < 1e-4: continue
        tau = (r[0]*d[1] - r[1]*d[0])/L
        cosb = float(np.cos(ar - np.deg2rad(base)))
        if cosb < 0.15: continue
        if sgn*tau < 0.08: continue
        score = cosb + 2.2*sgn*tau
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, dd, d, tau, cosb, q, L)
    if best is None: return None
    _, dd, d, tau, cosb, q, L = best
    s = float(np.clip(0.6*dist, 0.012, s_max))
    return {"d_deg": dd, "d": d, "tau": tau, "cosb": cosb, "q": q, "lever": L,

def wrap(a):
    return ((a + 180.0) % 360.0) - 180.0

def jaw_deg(j):
    return float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(j[1], j[0])))

def pick_jaw_neg(d, j_cur):
    """choose +-d whose roll change from j_cur is non-positive (the wrist unwinds only one way)"""
    th_c = jaw_deg(j_cur)
    best = None
    for cand in (np.asarray(d, float), -np.asarray(d, float)):
        dl = wrap(jaw_deg(cand) - th_c)
        if dl <= 0.5:
            return cand, dl
        if best is None or dl < best[1]: best = (cand, dl)
    return best

def mv(p, a, j, inter, speed="fast", label="", fracs=(1.0, 0.5)):
    p = np.array(p, float)
    for frac in fracs:
        for jj in (j, -np.asarray(j, float)):
            try:
                pp = p if frac >= 1.0 else (C.cur_pose()[0] + frac*(p - C.cur_pose()[0]))
                r = C.move_axes(pp, a, jj, inter, speed=speed, label=label)
                if r is not None and r.ok: return r
            except Exception as e:
                print("   %s refused %s (frac %.2f)" % (label, getattr(e, "code", type(e).__name__), frac))
    return None

def move_to_look(jaw_hint=np.array([0.0, -1.0])):
    tw, a, j = C.cur_pose()
    jt, dl = pick_jaw_neg(jaw_hint, j)
    print("   look jaw %.0f -> %.0f (d %.0f)" % (jaw_deg(j), jaw_deg(jt), dl))
    return mv(LOOK, np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0]), jt, "free_space", "fast", "look")

def go_home():
    try:
        r = tools.return_home(arms=[ARM])
        print("   return_home:", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code)
        return r
    except Exception as e:
        print("   return_home refused", getattr(e, "code", type(e).__name__))
        return None

def measure(tag="", verbose=True):
    obs = current()
    S, reg, bpoly, ppoly = pushlib.block_state(obs)
    al = pushlib.alignment(reg, bpoly, ppoly)
    iou = C.reg_quality(reg, bpoly, ppoly)
    ab, ap = bpoly.area, ppoly.area
    ok = (iou > 0.80) and (len(S["Pb"]) > 550) and (abs(ab-ap)/ap < 0.25)
    if verbose:

            len(S["Pb"]), len(S["Pp"]), S["Pb"][:, 2].min(), S["Pb"][:, 2].max(), ok))
    return al, pushlib.verts(bpoly), ok

def do_push(verts, c, d, s, foff, gap=0.014, lateral=None, tag=""):
    d = np.asarray(d, float); d /= np.linalg.norm(d)

    tw, a, j = C.cur_pose()
    jt, dl = pick_jaw_neg(d, j)
    print("   %s d=%.0f  jaw %.0f->%.0f (droll %.0f)" % (tag, np.degrees(np.arctan2(d[1], d[0])), jaw_deg(j), jaw_deg(jt), dl))
    r1 = mv(np.array([p_start[0], p_start[1], PRE_Z]), np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0]), jt, "free_space", "fast", "over")

    if r2 is None: return None
    tw3, a3, j3 = C.cur_pose()

    if r3 is None: return None
    print("   %s gap %.4f travel %.3f -> %s" % (tag, gap_now, s, r3.status))
    return r3

from ctl2 import *

        pl["d_deg"], pl["base"], pl["sin"], pl["need"], pl["sin_des"], pl["cosb"], pl["s"]))
    rr = home_cycle(verts, c, pl["d"], pl["s"], foff, tag="P%d" % i)
    if rr is None: print("  cycle failed"); break
    al2, v2, ok2 = measure("  after")
    if not ok2:
        if move_to_look() is None: go_home()
        al2, v2, ok2 = measure("  after2")
        if not ok2: handoff("measure unreliable after push", theta=al2["theta_deg"])
    print("    RESP dth %+.2f dc %s |dc| %.4f" % (al2["theta_deg"]-th,
          np.round(al2["c_block"]-c,4), float(np.linalg.norm(al2["dc"]))))
    al, verts = al2, v2

def plan_dir(verts, c, dc, theta_err, kth=617.0, kc=0.766, s_max=0.026):
    """direction whose torque/translation ratio matches the remaining error ratio"""
    base = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(dc[1], dc[0])))
    dist_mm = float(np.linalg.norm(dc))*1000.0
    need = abs(theta_err)/max(dist_mm, 1e-3)          # deg per mm needed
    sin_des = float(np.clip(need/(kth*0.001/kc), 0.12, 0.85))
    sgn = 1.0 if theta_err >= 0 else -1.0
    best = None
    for dd in np.arange(0.0, 360.0, 1.0):
        ar = np.deg2rad(dd); d2 = np.array([np.cos(ar), np.sin(ar)])
        q = C.support(verts, d2); r = q - c; L = np.linalg.norm(r)
        if L < 1e-4: continue
        sphi = (r[0]*d2[1] - r[1]*d2[0])/L
        if sgn*sphi < 0.05: continue
        cosb = float(np.cos(ar - np.deg2rad(base)))
        if cosb < 0.3: continue
        cost = 2.0*abs(sgn*sphi - sin_des) + 1.5*(1.0-cosb)
        if best is None or cost < best[0]:
            best = (cost, dd, np.array([d2[0], d2[1], 0.0]), sphi, cosb, L)
    if best is None: return None
    _, dd, d3, sphi, cosb, L = best
    s = float(np.clip(0.55*float(np.linalg.norm(dc)), 0.014, s_max))
    return {"d_deg": dd, "d": d3, "sin": sphi, "cosb": cosb, "sin_des": sin_des,
            "lever": L, "s": s, "base": base, "need": need}

def home_cycle(verts, c, d3, s, foff, gap=0.014, tag=""):
    """push from home and return home; leaves the arm home (good for measuring)."""
    if K2.go_home() is None: return None
    r = plan_and_push(verts, c, d3, s, foff, gap=gap, tag=tag, do_over=True)
    if r is None: return None
    tw, a, j = C.cur_pose()
    away = tw[:2] - np.asarray(c)[:2]; away /= max(np.linalg.norm(away), 1e-6)
    pr = tw.copy(); pr[2] = Z_PUSH; pr[:2] = tw[:2] + 0.035*away
    move_to(pr, a, j, "precision", "careful", "retreat")
    pu = pr.copy(); pu[2] = PRE_Z
    move_to(pu, a, j, "free_space", "fast", "up")
    if K2.go_home() is None: return None
    return r
